caption:
BFL has launched FLUX 3, a new multimodal foundation model that integrates video-action capabilities. The collaboration with Mimic Robotics has resulted in FLUX-mimic, a model tested in real-world scenarios at Audi. This advancement paves the way for robots to learn and predict actions in complex environments. 9164a1

Should robots be capable of predicting actions autonomously?
